text: Builds from before 9433918 on dev (sufr-dev at c69cc0a on catalyst; tmp-claude/2026-10-27-search-api-bench/sufr-old here) misorder suffixes starting at the last N of a run before the sequence delimiter under --dna -a: descending position with LCP 1. The N-run shortcut in `find_lcp` caused it. A byte comparison against such a build fails on any input with a run of N ending a record, hg38 among them. `test_n_runs_ending_a_record` in `libsufr/src/sufr_builder.rs` pins the right order.
